title: Parameter-dependent Trojan in a configurable FIFO
objective: Review the RTL source for a parameterized synchronous FIFO (param_fifo) and produce a security analysis report identifying any suspicious or malicious logic, including any parameterization under which the design's behavior deviates from the documented FIFO contract (full/empty flag correctness, no silent data corruption, no overwrite of unread data). Analysis must cover the legal parameter space (e.g. WIDTH = 8, 16, 24), not just the default configuration.
constraints: Participants must not edit files under inputs/; only submission/trojan_report.json is graded.
submission/trojan_report.json must be valid JSON with a top-level object containing 'findings' (array) and 'summary' (string).

Each element of 'findings' must include non-empty string fields 'trigger_condition', 'payload_effect', 'rationale', a numeric 'confidence' in [0.0, 1.0], and may optionally include 'affected_parameters'.

expected_outputs.summary: A single JSON report at submission/trojan_report.json listing trojan candidates (if any) found across the legal WIDTH parameter space of param_fifo, each with a specific triggering condition (including any parameter values and internal pointer/state patterns involved), a specific payload/effect described in terms of the FIFO's documented full/empty/data-integrity behavior, a confidence score, and a rationale.

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of graded cases where the submitted report correctly identifies the anomalous parameterization and payload as required by the hidden acceptance criteria.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of reported findings that do not correspond to the true anomaly location (e.g., flagging benign generate branches, unrelated parameter values, or normal reset/init logic as malicious).

metrics.name: trigger_payload_localization
metrics.description: Score (0-1) measuring how precisely the report localizes both the triggering condition and the payload/effect, based on keyword/semantic matching against the hidden ground truth and optional iverilog/vvp cross-simulation.

metrics.name: schema_validity
metrics.description: Whether submission/trojan_report.json parses as JSON and conforms to the required field schema.
